meta.title: KimKim - Gatherings, invites, and shared costs
meta.description: Plan the gathering, invite your people, track RSVPs, and split costs in one calm place. Built around Telegram.
meta.keywords: event planning, wedding, gap circle, sunnat to'y, aqiqa, challari, choyxona, birthday, Telegram, Uzbekistan

home.heroTitle:
Plan the gathering.
Keep everyone in sync.
home.heroSubtitle: Invites, RSVPs, location, comments, and shared costs in one simple place.
home.heroSubtitleSignedIn: Events, guests, updates, and expenses are all in one place.

features.eventsBody: Set the date, place, guest list, and payment style without extra noise.
features.commentsBody: Use one thread for updates, venue choices, tasks, and small decisions.
features.expensesBody: Log payments, split costs, and see balances before the awkward part.
features.telegramBody: Share invites, send reminders, and post updates where the group already talks.
